title: Quick answers, llms files and the Organization node state the December 1, 2026 opening in North County San Diego (SCAN-1023)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. OPENING_DATE_ISO, OPENING_DATE_LABEL and FOUNDING_CITIES live in lib/site.ts. The Where is Frequency available answer, the llms.txt and llms-full.txt blockquotes read the label; the Organization node gains areaServed (the region plus six cities). The pricing calculator persona chip says Instructors and coaches. Daniel said change it (2026-10-22): who-its-for.ts says Instructors (its test pin moved to /instructors/i), and foundingLocation carries addressRegion CA and addressCountry US instead of the region as a locality.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];if(!r('lib/site.ts').includes('OPENING_DATE_LABEL'))bad.push('no opening constant');if(!r('lib/marketing/quick-answers.ts').includes('OPENING_DATE_LABEL'))bad.push('quick answer lacks the date');if(!r('app/llms.txt/route.ts').includes('OPENING_DATE_LABEL'))bad.push('llms.txt lacks the date');if(!r('lib/jsonld.ts').includes('areaServed'))bad.push('Organization lacks areaServed');if(r('components/frequency/site/pages/pricing/calculator-model.ts').includes('Teachers and coaches'))bad.push('calculator still says Teachers');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1023: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the opening date or area served drops out of the answer block, llms files or Organization node.
